name: sdocx-bridge
description: Let Claude read Samsung Notes (.sdocx) and PDFs, transcribe note recordings locally, and write text into them as real pen strokes in your own handwriting.
long_description: Inkbridge runs on your computer. Claude can open .sdocx and .pdf files from your Downloads, Documents and Desktop folders (and any folders you add), look at every page, read stroke timing, transcribe recordings with a free local Whisper model, and write text in your handwriting as vector ink: PDF ink annotations, or new strokes added to a copy of the Samsung Notes file. Originals are never modified and nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: find_files
tools.description: Find .sdocx/.pdf files in the allowed folders

tools.name: open_file
tools.description: Import a note or PDF (the original is not changed)

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Pages, typed text, recordings and attachments of a note

tools.name: view_page
tools.description: Look at a page (optionally zoomed, with a coordinate grid)

tools.name: page_layout
tools.description: Lines of writing and blank space on a page

tools.name: read_strokes
tools.description: Stroke geometry and timing of a page

tools.name: recording_timeline
tools.description: What was written during each minute of a recording

tools.name: transcribe_recording
tools.description: Transcribe a recording locally with Whisper (free)

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Transcript sentences with the handwriting written at that moment

tools.name: write_handwriting
tools.description: Write text as real pen strokes in your handwriting into a PDF, a note copy, or a new page

tools.name: export_note
tools.description: Export a note as PDF, SVG, JSON, Markdown, or its recordings

tools.name: save_copy
tools.description: Copy a result into an allowed folder

tools.name: learn_character
tools.description: Teach a missing character from strokes in a note

prompts.name: read_handwriting
prompts.description: Read every handwritten page of a note
prompts.text: Read all handwriting in note ${arguments.note_id}: view each page (zoom into dense areas) and transcribe it faithfully, page by page.

prompts.name: fill_missing_notes
prompts.description: Transcribe the recording and fill what is missing from the notes in my handwriting
prompts.text: Transcribe the recording of note ${arguments.note_id}, compare it with the handwriting, and write what is missing near the related notes in my handwriting. Show me the result.

library.title: 작업 폴더 (Library folder)
library.description: Where imported notes, transcripts and results are kept. Originals are never changed.

glyph_file.title: 내 손글씨 파일 glyphs.json (Handwriting glyphs)
glyph_file.description: Your handwriting dictionary (glyphs.json). It stays on this computer and is installed as the 'my-handwriting' profile.

extra_dirs.title: 추가로 열 수 있는 폴더 (Extra folders)
extra_dirs.description: Downloads, Documents and Desktop are allowed already. Add folders such as a cloud-synced Samsung Notes folder.
